international.title: Burnham faces Badenoch at PMQs as Lammy urges PM to commit to rejoining EU – UK politics live
international.summary: Former foreign secretary has urged Andy Burnham to make rejoining a manifesto commitment Lammy urges Burnham to fight next election on rejoining EU In her speech today, Shabana Mahmood , the home secretary, will also announce plans for a new fast-stream police leadership programme for up to 200 recruits a year. Vikram Dodd has the details. The Conservatives and Reform UK do not seem very impressed by Shabana Mahmood’s proposal to meet their concerns about two-tier policing. If you don’t want two-tier justice, stop legislating for it. Stop training people for it. Last year the Home Office believed claims of “two-tier” policing were “far-right”. Will they now apologise? Even in her statement Mahmood still can’t bring herself to say it’s wrong. Continue reading...
